main_statements.label: Theorem 1
main_statements.quantifiers: forall integer m>=1, forall complex u in H^m
limits: Scalar vanishing is proved on every complex H^m input using the analytic physical even Hamiltonian extension, compatible with the original higher-regularity hierarchy.

Both clauses hold on all original complex H^m inputs with the independently constructed K_m on complex H^(m-1), including m=1. Its actual Frechet gradient is constructed on that native domain; Gardner differentiation is the genuine physical distribution derivative.
The literal physical Hill trace at r^2 has all-order real-axis estimates with odd phase coefficients 2*K_m.

The independently constructed physical Hill sheets now agree with the original NLS root and primitive on the entire original real H1 right-half-plane cut complement, including real bands. The physical Hill trace and energy derivative, first-band normalization, ground-endpoint limit and actual path integral are proved there. Complex H1 source analyticity remains certified on the earlier source-continuation domain. Full spectral action and Hamiltonian identification remains open.

The physical H1 Miura potential, actual L2 Hill operator spectrum and characteristic multiplicities, fixed positive gap indices, full real-H1 sheets and real-H1 inverse-energy-weighted mKdV spectral actions are now constructed and compared. Full source spectral Hamiltonian calibration and complex source action/frequency machinery remain open.

The independently defined physical Hill primitive now has the convergent source Laurent series with exact native K coefficients at every real finite-gap H1 source, including exterior collapsed gaps and zero mean. This uses the finite-gap locus of the intrinsic physical Hill labels, proved equivalent to finite support of actual mKdV actions and to the original NLS finite-gap locus. Identification/uniqueness on the entire original complex native Sobolev domains is still open.

main_statements.label: Theorem 2(i)
main_statements.quantifiers: forall integer k>=1, forall phi in complex H^(k-1) pairs, forall real alpha

gradient_dependency.scope: Every admissible hierarchy order on H^s with k<=s+1, including k=1 on H0; analytic L2 coefficients represent the actual complex Frechet derivative and agree with the physical first variation on smooth fields.

main_statements.label: Theorem 2(ii)
main_statements.quantifiers: forall integer m>=1, forall phi in complex H^(2m-1) pairs, if exists real alpha with P phi=R_alpha phi

main_statements.label: Theorem 3
main_statements.quantifiers: forall integers n>=1 and m>=1, on real H^(m-1)
main_statements.source_issue: The p.18 proof gives eta=omega without this parity factor; reconcile the physical conventions before formalizing.

main_statements.label: Theorem 4(i)
main_statements.quantifiers: forall real u in H1; forall positive n
main_statements.target: I_0#=0 iff mean=0; I_n#=0 iff J_n=0; I_(-n)#=I_n#
limits: All three clauses are proved on every original real H1 input and every positive natural index, including zero mean and collapsed gaps.

The physical mKdV action contour exists for every such input; it lies in the actual Hill gap complement, has winding one about its intrinsic selected Hill gap, winding zero at other positive gaps and at the origin.

The action is independent of the checked contour family. Arbitrary close piecewise frequency circuits have the full integer-level winding formula after squaring; winding-one circuits give the same physical action.
The actual real-gap representation gives J_n=I_n/(2*zeta_n) for some positive zeta_n in the original positive frequency gap. This never divides by an action or gap length.
Complex-source analytic action neighborhoods, action factorization, angles and frequency identities belong to Theorem 4(ii)-(iii) and Theorem 3 and remain open.
main_statements.action_definition: NLS.MKdV.miuraNLSAction is the original sourceIndexedAction on sobolevSourceInclusion(a,a). NLS.MKdV.miuraMKdVAction is -(4*pi)^(-1) times the actual integral of mu^(-1)*canonicalMiuraHillPrimitive on a certified isolating energy loop. Neither is defined by the desired zero criterion.

main_statements.label: Theorem 4(ii)
main_statements.target: Real analytic factorization of I# through J and mean; converse factorization of J and printed signed mean through I.
main_statements.source_issue: Global signed mean recovery from NLS actions alone needs a branch restriction or sign-invariant correction.
limits: Every original restricted NLS action at every signed index, including zero, commutes with every positive actual mKdV action under the genuine Gardner bracket on real H1. The normal-form factorization is not inferred merely from this commutation; it remains to be proved. The signed-mean correction/branch remains necessary.

main_statements.label: Theorem 4(iii)
main_statements.quantifiers: Every original real H1 input; every positive m,n; the angle at m is defined when its own actual mKdV action J_m is nonzero. No nonzero/open-gap hypothesis is imposed on the action J_n.
main_statements.target: Gardner bracket of theta_m# and J_n equals delta_mn; angle sum depends on actions and mean.
main_statements.angle_definition: The actual NLS theta phase is supplied by the checked original normalized psi/common-domain construction and pulled back along the literal L2 diagonal. Its logarithmic differential is proved equal to the pullback of the original local NLS angle differential.
main_statements.Gardner_definition: The scalar gradient is constructed from the actual L2 Frechet derivative; its spatial Fourier multiplier is 2*pi*i*m. Square summability of that derivative and equality with the actual period-one tempered distribution derivative are proved at every original real H1 input.
limits: The printed angle-action bracket clause is proved with the original +delta_mn sign. The concluding assertion about the independently constructed mKdV angle vartheta_m plus theta_m# being an analytic function of mKdV actions and mean still requires mKdV angle construction and factorization. Theorem 4(iii) as a whole remains incomplete.

dependency_labels.label: Theorem 5
dependency_labels.quantifiers: forall original complex period-one H1 input a, forall complex z, including z=0
dependency_labels.physical_identification: Independent Hill columns have initial conditions (1,0) and (0,1) in position/derivative coordinates; both column and derivative are absolutely continuous; the actual equation -g_second+(u_prime+u_squared)*g=mu*g holds almost everywhere; physical uniqueness is proved. The literal Miura coefficients define an analytic H1-to-L2 potential map. The shared L2 Hill monodromy and H2 periodic Hill operator are identified with the original quasi-Hill IVP at all complex energies, including zero.

dependency_labels.label: Proposition 6
limits: The full complex native scalar hierarchy identity is proved and its physical spectral Laurent calibration is proved at all real finite-gap H1 sources. Identifying the source spectral hierarchy by extension/uniqueness on the entire original complex H^(m-1) domain remains open.

dependency_labels.label: Lemma 7
dependency_labels.quantifiers: Every original real H1 input; every positive gap index n; every integer level k, including k=1 mapping to NLS level zero. Actual positive isolating circuits and their squared energy images. A single open subset of the full complex L2 pair source space contains the entire real L2 diagonal before n and k are chosen; all positive n and all integer k are analytic there, with exact restriction to 2*J_(n,k) on every real H1 input.
dependency_labels.normalization: J_(n,k)=-(4*pi)^(-1) integral(mu^(k-2)*F_Hill dmu); I_(n,2k-2)=-pi^(-1) integral(z^(2k-3)*F_NLS dz); dmu=2*z dz, hence 2*J_(n,k)=I_(n,2k-2).
limits: Complete: real contour identity, actual isolating geometry, integer Laurent weights, winding independence, and the ambient complex L2 extension clause. The central NLS index is not part of Lemma 7 and is not included in the Laurent atlas.

dependency_labels.scope: Actual full source Frechet derivatives on every real H1 diagonal, all noncentral indices, all integer levels and every physical Fourier mode. The specialized sum/difference recurrence is sufficient for the proved Gardner transfer.
limits: No claim of the full arbitrary-source phase/spatial-reflection variants of Lemma 10.

dependency_labels.quantifiers: forall original period-one H1 coefficient input a with a_n=conjugate(a_-n), forall complex z with Re z>0 outside every original closed canonical NLS gap; real spectral bands are included
limits: The full physical Hill sheets are nonreal-energy limits of the independent quasi-Hill IVP/source-continuation constructions. Equality with the NLS sheets proves existence and analyticity of these limits across every real band, rather than defining the new values by NLS.

This completes the source real-H1 assertion. Joint complex-H1 source analyticity on arbitrary real-band neighborhoods and the weighted mKdV action contours remain separate later obligations.

dependency_labels.label: Lemma 3
dependency_labels.quantifiers: All original complex H1 inputs for spectral sets and analytic multiplicities; all conjugate-reflected real H1 inputs for nonnegativity, intrinsic labels, central endpoints and every natural index n>=1 in the fixed endpoint and gap identities.
limits: Every actual H2 Hill eigenvalue condition is equivalent to the original ZS periodic spectral condition at squared frequency, including zero.
At nonzero frequency the energy characteristic order is the original ZS algebraic multiplicity; at zero the frequency multiplicity is exactly twice the energy order.
The intrinsic ordered real Hill labels have the exact characteristic zero set and analytic multiplicities and are nonnegative.

Every fixed positive Hill endpoint is the square of the corresponding original canonical NLS endpoint; the central Hill endpoint is the square of either central NLS endpoint. Closed gaps are exact square images and collapse simultaneously. The printed geometric-eigenspace multiplicity comparison remains open. No action-integral comparison is asserted.
